presentationTable.name: Store

presentationColumns.name: Store Code
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Stable business code for the physical store. Use this when you need an unambiguous store identifier that will not change if the display name changes.

presentationColumns.name: Store Name
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Unique business-facing store label. Names include city and neighborhood or street so OAC filters and AI Assistant prompts do not merge multiple physical stores.

presentationColumns.name: Country
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Country where the store operates.

presentationColumns.name: Region
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Commercial region or subnational geography used for store analysis, such as Greater London, Bavaria, Catalonia, or Lombardy.

presentationColumns.name: City
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. City where the store operates.

presentationColumns.name: Store Format
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Retail format of the store, such as Flagship, High Street, Mall, or Outlet.

presentationColumns.name: Location Type
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Broad location classification such as Urban, Mall, or Outlet Village.

presentationColumns.name: Opening Date
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Date when the store opened. Use it for store maturity and lifecycle analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Selling Area SQM
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Approximate selling area in square meters. Use it to compare store scale and normalize traffic or inventory exposure.

presentationColumns.name: Climate Zone
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Climate classification for the store location, useful for seasonal assortment and weather-sensitive product analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Affluence Index
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Relative affluence indicator for the store catchment area. Use it as context for price tier, full-price demand, and assortment mix.

presentationColumns.name: Is Flagship
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Flags flagship stores. Use it to separate high-profile brand locations from standard stores.

presentationColumns.name: Is Outlet
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Flags outlet stores. Use it to separate clearance and outlet behavior from full-price retail stores.

presentationColumns.name: Latitude
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Store latitude for map visualizations and geographic analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Longitude
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Store longitude for map visualizations and geographic analysis.
